string-array.name: onb_story
string-array.item: Working with a lot of service providers, I noticed how they do [[personal branding]].
The one common thing they all do is, they share helpful tips about their service.
But there is a twist here. However good content you create, if you don\'t publish regularly and consistently, the social media algorithm will never show your posts to [[more audience]].
And these days, video content gets the most reach.
Now here is a thing. Which style of video can create the most trust?
In recent years, people got very unreliable service behind perfectly edited motion graphics videos.
So fancy but faceless videos still get views, but not [[trust]].
A real human face, speaking sincerely, creates [[more trust]] than a highly edited video.
And this is exactly what service providers are doing now.
After recording, the video needs editing.
Moreover, you have to write a well planned script before creating the video.
Every platform needs a different video shape.
So to do all this work every day, service providers hire two kinds of people:
1. A video editor, so that consistency is never missed.
2. A social media manager, to work on the social platforms regularly.
For the last three years I was thinking how to bring this [[cost]] down.
Then I developed a software system where you just open the app and start talking. [[2-3 minutes]] of talking, then close the app.
Now whatever work needs to be done, [[the app does all the rest]].
